The '''Bamula sector''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and contained the [[Chorra system/Legends|Chorra]] and [[Donadus system/Legends|Donadus systems]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The former was the origin point of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group known as the [[Chorran shipjacker|Chorran Shipjackers]].<ref name="EOTE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Chorran shipjacker|Chorran Shipjackers]]|system=[[Chorra system/Legends|Chorra system]]|legends=1}}</ref> The latter contained the astronomical object [[Donadus]], out of which the Shipjackers operated.<ref name="HuntWithin1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin1|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1}}</ref> Donadus also shared its name with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Donadi]].<ref name="BtS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>

Before the [[Declaration of a New Order|ascension]] to power of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="Journal8">{{JournalCite|8|The Yard of Opportunity}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the famed military organization known as the [[Flamestrike Legion]] defended the Bamula [[Sector/Legends|sector]] from foreign insurrections. Upon the expansion of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Legion was disbanded.<ref name="Journal8" /> At some point between [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin2|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 2|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 2}} establishes that [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] at some point between the [[assault on Doniphon]] and the [[attack on Anglebay Station]]. The scenario also dates the latter conflict to a few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Since {{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-11-serving-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 11: Serving the Empire}} dates the assault on [[Doniphon]] to [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Valance must therefore have become a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] at some point between those two dates.</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]] led a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in routing the Donadus-based pirates, a mission that helped Valance attain the status of an elite [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]].<ref name="HuntWithin1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bamula sector was introduced in "[[The Yard of Opportunity]]," an article written by [[Christopher M. Olson|Chris Olson]] and published in [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 8]] in [[November]] [[1995]].<ref name="Journal8" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Bamula sector's Chorra and Donadus systems in grid square J-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
